purpose: Dead-man switch. If heartbeats stop arriving, the CLOB automatically cancels all of the user's open orders.
intervalNote: No official page states a beat interval or a silence timeout. Any interval constant in an SDK is a local choice, not pinned evidence.

current.requestBodyNote: The operation declares no requestBody. The signed L2 payload therefore covers timestamp + POST + /heartbeats with an empty body.

idChainingVariant.chainingRule: The response returns a new heartbeat_id that must be sent on the next request; a mismatch returns 400 with the expected id.
idChainingVariant.note: Present in clob-openapi.yaml but absent from llms.txt, which lists only the bodyless POST /heartbeats. Treat the bodyless contract as current and this one as an unlisted alternative.
